camera._comment: Frame is captured 1280x720 by picamera2 then rotated 90° CW in face_source.py, so width/height are swapped here. HFOV/VFOV likewise swapped vs the Pi cam native landscape FOV. focal_px placeholder = width_px / (2*tan(hfov/2)); recalibrate with a known face width at a known distance: focal_px = bbox_width_px * distance_m / real_width_m.

mount._comment: Measure on the assembled turret. height = how far above the tilt pivot the camera lens sits; forward = how far ahead of the pivot.

sound._comment: Maximum number of seconds to play the shoot sound. Set to 0 or null to let the whole file play.

camera_stream._comment: MJPEG stream served at /api/camera/stream when enabled. Lower fps/quality/size uses less CPU and network.
